unit.why: A single narrative: two grandchildren of R. Yehuda Zvi of Rozla are dangerously ill, Psalms fail, and R. Moshe of Sambor's letter placed under their pillows heals them.

stories.start_quote: פ״א היו שני נכדי בנו הקדוש
stories.summary_en: Two grandchildren of R. Yehuda Zvi of Rozla are dangerously ill. He sees a vision of his late master R. Zvi with two holes in his heart, and three recitations of Psalms do not help. His father R. Moshe of Sambor then sends a letter decreeing their recovery; once it is placed under their pillows, they are healed at once. R. Yitzhak Isaac of Zidichov later retells the story.
